title: UserProfile
description: The authenticated user's Snapchat profile information. Fields available depend on the scopes granted during authorization.

externalId.description: The unique external identifier for the user on the Snapchat platform.

displayName.description: The user's Snapchat display name. Requires the user.display_name scope.

bitmoji.description: The user's Bitmoji avatar information. Requires the user.bitmoji.avatar scope.

avatar.description: URL to the user's Bitmoji avatar image.

id.description: The unique identifier of the user's Bitmoji.
